_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Naval Aviation System Sanitization
summary: Naval Aviation System Sanitization is used to identify collateral classified and controlled unclassified information and semiconductor and magnetic storage in each Weapons Replaceable Assembly.
use_relationship:
System Sanitization is be used to identify all collateral classified and controlled unclassified information (CUI) as per the program security classification guide. Identify all semiconductor memory which includes battery backed random access memory and magnetic data storage devices in each Weapons Replaceable Assembly (WRA).
This DID contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data product resulting from the work task described in the contract statement of work (SOW).
This DID supersedes DI-MGMT-82149.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Referenced Documents.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

children.title: National Institute of Standards and Technology Special Publication (NIST SP) 800-88r1 Guidelines for Media Sanitization Dec 2014.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall contain the following:

children.title: Program Manager's Name and Telephone Number.

Describe the systems and subsystems that store, process or transmit controlled unclassified information and collateral classified data as per the program security classification guide and subsequent NIST SP 800-88 sanitization methodology.
For systems that require purging, describe proposed sanitization methods that will be addressed and are such that they meet the applicable guidance of the NIST SP 800-88 and the United States Navy.

preparation_instructions.title: Appendices may be used for each individual subsystem, e.g., mission management system, vehicle management system, Link-16 system, communications system.
preparation_instructions.content: Sanitization is the removal of information from the storage device such that data recovery using any known technique or analysis is prevented.
